## TASK
Re-screen exactly 6 supplied full-text reports C05, C06, C07, C08, C09, C10 for the HK261 multi-UAV collaborative neural inference review, independently of prior inclusion labels.

## REQUIRED WORK
1. Read the supplied complete text for every report, including model, methods, evaluation and conclusion; use its PDF if extraction is ambiguous. File page markers are 1-based PDF pages. Never infer content from the title hint.
2. Copy the full bibliographic title, all authors in source order, year, venue, DOI, and actual source version. Label preprints explicitly and never infer peer review from a filename.
3. Evaluate six gates: primary_full_report; multi_uav_evaluated; collaborative_inference; evaluative_evidence; date_window; english. Multi-UAV requires an evaluated system with at least two UAVs, not an introduction-only mention. Collaborative inference includes distributed/partitioned/assigned/migrated/fused inference execution, features, layers, requests or resources across a multi-UAV edge/cloud hierarchy. A DNN used only as an optimization solver is NOT an inference workload. Static training/ensemble creation without runtime inference orchestration is not sufficient. A demo/poster abstract is not a full research paper. Mathematical performance studies are eligible evaluative evidence under protocol 4.1(4); no simulation, physical deployment or executed-DNN requirement may be invented. Connect analytical evaluations explicitly to the evaluated multi-UAV architecture.
4. For each gate give YES/NO/UNCERTAIN, concise factual rationale, 1-based PDF page, and a short exact contiguous supporting quote from that page (10–45 words maximum). For a negative/absence judgment cite the actual described system/evaluation and explain what remains absent; never fabricate an absence quote. Date window is 2021-01-01 through 2026-11-25. For year-only 2026 evidence, mark date UNCERTAIN unless the full report provides a dated publication record before cutoff; acceptance date alone does not establish publication date.
5. Decide INCLUDE only when all six gates are YES; EXCLUDE if at least one is NO and give one primary reason; otherwise UNCERTAIN. Every record must have a nonempty primary_reason: INCLUDE names all six YES gates; EXCLUDE names one primary failed gate; UNCERTAIN names unresolved gates. Classify evaluation mode and dissertation alignment from full text. Do not score prestige or citation counts and do not force a target inclusion count.
6. Explicitly list unresolved identity, date, version, scope and possible study-family overlaps. Use provided DOI as a lookup key only, not evidence that the PDF matches it.

def get_page_text(pid, page_num):

    ("C06", 1, "Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV)-assisted mobile edge computing is pivotal for the Space–Air–Ground–Sea Integrated Network (SAGSIN) to support heterogeneous task offloading."),

    ("C07", 7, "However, while a swarm of drones flies around and separately sends offloading queries, the edge server is obliged to serve multiple DNN models and infer their navigation decisions."),

    ("C08", 6, "In addition, we contrast our work with related literature (§ 2), discuss legal issues and limitations (§ 9) and offer our conclusions and future work (§ 10)."),
    ("C08", 23, "These are combined with 2, 3 or 4 buddy drones (2D/3D/4D) per VIP that concurrently send video streams to an edge base station for the VIP."),

    ("C08", 1, "Drone fleets with onboard cameras coupled with computer vision and DNN inferencing models can support diverse applications, from package deliveries to disaster monitoring."),
    ("C08", 5, "We propose a deadline-driven scheduling heuristic DEMS-A for drones that incorporates strategies for preemptive dropping of tasks based on earliest deadline, their migration from edge to cloud, work stealing from cloud back to edge, with adaptation to network variability (§ 5)."),

    ("C09", 3, "We ground the system model in a concrete mission: autonomous search-and-rescue (SAR) over a remote disaster area where ground infrastructure (base stations, edge servers, and reliable backhaul) has been destroyed or was never available."),

    ("C09", 7, "NetMoE accordingly adopts a hierarchical control architecture, illustrated in Fig. 1, in which two decision components run on the Center UAV’s logical control plane at different timescales: (i) a centralized online trajectory planner"),
    ("C10", 1, "This article has been accepted for publication in IEEE Internet of Things Journal. This is the author\x27s version which has not been fully edited and content may change prior to final publication. Citation information: DOI 10.1109/JIOT.2026.3740035"),
    ("C10", 2, "The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II reviews related work. Section III presents the system model. Section IV describes the DDCI algorithm. Section V reports experimental results. Section VI concludes the paper."),
    ("C10", 10, "The swarm comprises N = 10 UAVs with heterogeneous compute capacities Ci ∈ {160, 320, 400, 600, 800} GFLOPS, corresponding to embedded UAV processors ranging from low-power modules to high-end accelerators (Section V-A), communicating over Wi-Fi 802.11ac within radius Rcomm = 200 m."),
    ("C10", 1, "To address this, we propose DDCI, a decentralized collaborative inference framework in which each UAV autonomously selects a collaboration partner and a DNN partition point through a locally executed deep reinforcement learning (DRL) policy."),
    ("C10", 10, "We implement the decentralized UAV swarm environment as a custom Gymnasium environment and train DRL agents using Stable-Baselines3 with PyTorch. Each episode simulates Tsim = 400 s of operation, and each configuration is evaluated over 30 independent episodes."),
    ("C10", 1, "Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms are increasingly deployed for mission-critical tasks that demand real-time deep neural network (DNN) inference. However, the limited on-board computation of each UAV and the dynamic, infrastructure-free topology of the swarm make efficient inference challenging."),
    ("C10", 6, "At each decision epoch, a UAV processes an incoming task through four stages: (1) neighbor discovery within the communication range, (2) Pareto-optimal filtering to select a fixed-size candidate set, (3) DRL-based joint decision on partner selection and model partition point")
]

for pid, pnum, q in checks:
    txt = norm(get_page_text(pid, pnum))
    qn = norm(q)
    wc = len(qn.split())
    ok = qn in txt
    if not ok:
        # try ignoring apostrophe/quote/space differences
        txt_loose = re.sub(r"\s+", "", txt.lower())
        q_loose = re.sub(r"\s+", "", qn.lower())
        loose_ok = q_loose in txt_loose
        print(f"MISMATCH {pid} p.{pnum} (wc={wc}, loose={loose_ok}): {qn}")
        if not loose_ok:
            print("  PAGE SAMPLE:", txt[:500])
    else:
        if wc < 10 or wc > 45:
            print(f"WC_WARN {pid} p.{pnum} (wc={wc}): {qn}")
        else:
            print(f"OK {pid} p.{pnum} (wc={wc})")
'
